description: What Jev answered about each line of the values of one day now (4, third rule): sent when a line is queued, answered, or fails, and when the settings, the chosen evaluators or the Jev key change which lines are checked.

day.description: The journal day whose values these are.

values.description: Every value with a line Jev has answered, is checking, or could not check, in the values' order; a row still being written is left out until the user finishes it, and every value is left out while the account has no Jev key.

items.description: One value of the day, with its checked lines in the order value, example.
One line of the value that Jev has answered, is checking, or could not check.

line.description: value: the value itself, read alone. example: the example of living it, read together with the value.

text.description: The line as written in the sheet: the value's name, or its example.

status.description: pending: waiting for Jev. done: answered. failed: Jev could not be asked; error says why.

answers.description: Jev's answers to every question of the line's evaluator; empty until done.

items.description: Jev's answer to one question about the line.

option.description: An answer of the question: the id of a pick question's option, or yes or no for a yes / no question.

name.description: The answer as the user sees it: the option's name, or Yes or No.

p.description: How likely Jev holds the answer to be.

unexpected.description: The names of the answers that are not the one their question expects; empty when every answer is the expected one or no question expects one.

error.description: Why the last check failed, as llm: decide said it; left out when nothing failed.
